name: Suffer the Past
oracle_text: Exile X target cards from target player's graveyard. For each card exiled this way, that player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
blocked_sentences: Exile X target cards from target player's graveyard.

needs.what: An X-sized spell target (count {"x": true}) whose selector names a sibling target declared before it -- {"kind": "card_in_graveyard", "count": {"x": true}, "selector": {"zone": "graveyard", "player": {"target": "graveyard_owner"}}} after a {"kind": "player"} target -- so the X cards are chosen from the graveyard of the player already picked. Game._ask_x_targets must pass the already-declared refs (the `chosen` mapping enumerate_target_tuples uses for linked specs) into targeting.candidates, and resolution must re-check the link
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Both halves load and pass gates 1-3: linked siblings work for fixed-size specs (enumerate_target_tuples grows partials with `chosen`), and X-sized specs work alone (Curse of the Swine, Crackle with Power). But Game._ask_x_targets calls candidates(state, pid, spec, oid) with no `chosen`, so a selector reading {"target": "graveyard_owner"} resolves against no answer and offers nothing. Verified with verify(): the cast targets P0, X is announced as 20, zero cards are targeted, nothing is exiled and no life changes (graveyard_size stays 3) -- the card would be inert. Dropping the link (controller "any") would let the X cards come from several graveyards, which is a different card
